text: There's a damp patch on the bedroom ceiling that's got much bigger since yesterday, it's gone soft and is bulging down in the middle. No water dripping yet. 12 Primrose Bank.
notes: Borderline. Water is not yet coming through, so the rule does not fire literally; a soft bulging ceiling is water held above it and can collapse. Labelled Emergency (AI should raise) and Plumbing (leak above), not Unsure-damp. See README limits: labeller judgement.
